examples.text: A nurse starts each shift with a short prayer before the first patient arrives, and that habit carries her through the day.
A small group shares one answered prayer each week and goes home encouraged.

humor.text: A branch that tries to go solo ends up as firewood, not fruit.
humor.purpose: It shows that we bear fruit only when we stay connected to the vine.

humor.text: Even my phone knows it needs to stay plugged in to keep going.
humor.purpose: It pictures abiding: we need to stay connected to bear fruit.
